text: You're right, and sorry: the 'All agree' chip (it showed as 'Al') was on my list since earlier today but I hadn't fixed it, and my chat watcher wasn't running so I missed that you'd flagged it again. Fixed now: that row wraps onto a second line instead of clipping, and I also made the PropLine screen's filter rows (league chips were cutting WNBA to 'WNB') wrap the same way. I'm bundling it into one release with the other fixes from today (spent-key bars, chat keyboard, PropLine calibrated edge + hit rates) and will message you when it's out.
